name: COMP_029
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (56%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Input is flagged [F6], the second model (MUSK) disagrees, and 0 of 5 neighbors are InSitu [F5].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 56%, Normal 27%, Benign 14%, Invasive 2% | InSitu leads, not dominant |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign, InSitu (90%) | Cannot separate three classes |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.08 · 90th percentile | Input flagged as suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Top class differs |
| Similar cases | 0/5 InSitu (3 Benign, 2 Normal) | Neighbors lean benign/normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 6, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; linked to lower invasive likelihood · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Benign background; linked to lower invasive likelihood · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 6, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · Elevated score, but failed spot check (3/20) · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Small push toward invasive; highest region risk (7%) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions lowers the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to match the classifier. Unreliable here: necrosis, mitoses, normal lobules.

## Could be wrong if
- Reliability is 0.08 and flagged, so the probabilities themselves may be off.
- Invasive (2%) lies outside the set, but the flagged input weakens that exclusion.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 10, 11**: check for atypical cells within ducts; verify necrosis.
2. **Region 8**: check for stromal invasion; highest region risk (7%).
3. **Regions 5, 1**: largest pull away from invasive; confirm normal lobules or glands.
